fields.acceptance: Go tests in internal/api (go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run ShipGHRetry) with a fake Exec and an injected clock (no real sleep) assert: open-pr whose gh pr create fails twice with 'HTTP 502' then succeeds passes after three calls; a 'GraphQL: Something went wrong' error is retried the same way; four 5xx failures fail the step naming the last error; an HTTP 422 or 'no pull requests found' is not retried.
fields.statement: Ship steps retry a gh call that fails with a GitHub server error (HTTP 5xx), a timeout or a GraphQL 'Something went wrong' error up to three times with growing waits before failing the step, and fail at once on any other error, so a GitHub blip no longer holds a run.

fields.acceptance: Go tests in internal/api (go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run ShipPushDiverged) on scratch repos with a bare origin assert: open-pr and rebase, with origin's branch one commit ahead on a file the local branch did not touch, merge it and push, and origin's history keeps that commit; with a conflicting origin commit the step stops with a detail naming the commit and leaves no merge in progress; no call uses --force or rebase.
fields.statement: When a ship step's push is refused because the run's branch on origin holds commits the local branch lacks, the step fetches origin's branch and merges it (never force-pushes or rebases) when it merges cleanly, then pushes; a conflicting merge stops the run naming the origin commits.

fields.acceptance: Go tests in internal/api (go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run ShipLand) assert a land whose head build exits 3 with 'cannot land change set X: node N changed' reports a conflict naming node N (not a plain failure), and a testscript (go test -trimpath ./cmd/rhiza -run TestScripts/<the ship land conflict script>) runs ship-change with a fake gh to the conflict-fix step after that land failure; any other land failure still fails land with the head build's detail (ship-head-build-error-detail).
fields.statement: A ship land that fails because the PR head's rhiza refuses to land (exit 3, a node the change set edits changed on main) merges origin/main into the branch and hands the conflict to the run's conflict fixer, instead of failing land and holding the run.

fields.acceptance: Go tests in internal/api (go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run 'ActorRecord|SessionRun') assert: recording the actor of a session whose handle is already held by a landed actor writes no new node and returns the existing one; the same holds when an in-flight change set (another run's branch merged in) holds it; rhiza check on the result reports no duplicate handle.
fields.statement: Recording an agent actor for a session whose actor handle a landed or in-flight change set already holds reuses that actor instead of writing a second node with the same handle, so review's code check no longer fails on a duplicate actor handle.

fields.acceptance: Go tests in internal/api (go test -trimpath ./internal/api -run SessionRunRexRetry) with a fake rex and an injected clock assert: two failed tab opens then a success start the session with one tab; four failures fail naming Rex's last error; no test starts a real Rex or agent.
fields.statement: Opening a run session's Rex tab retries a failed rex call (Rex not answering, or no window ID returned) up to three times with growing waits before failing, so a Rex hiccup no longer holds a run.
